_: THE SWEEP THAT SAYS THE TYPE WALK READS A FIELD NAME WITH A DIGIT — run it
WHAT THE CONTRACT IS. `ref_field_classification.rs` walks the store's types
from source. Its field parser accepted only lowercase letters and `_`, so
`spec_sha256` was not a field: `ArtifactHashes` parsed as a type with no body,
was never classified, was never required to deny unknown fields, and read
past an unknown key inside every confirmation event while every law passed.
Seven String places carrying a digit had the same fate in the classification.
TWO INJECTIONS, one per law the blind spot hid from. Restoring the old
character rule must turn the witness red AND the classification law red —
the seven rows it now carries become stale, which is how that law says its
population shrank. Removing the attribute from `ArtifactHashes` must turn the
unknown-key law red, which it could not do before the walk could see the type.
RUN IT LOCALLY. The harness edits this tree and writes the firing record

injections.name: a-digit-ends-the-field-name
injections.why: the walk as it was: a field name with a digit is not a field, so a type made only of such fields has no body and every law over the store reports clean about it

injections.name: the-artifact-hashes-read-past-a-key
injections.why: the store type the blind spot actually hid: a confirmation event's hashes read past an unknown key and the next save erases it
